status: Lost Canyon playable dialogue; Marksman finale remains next

ward.name: Captain Ward
ward.role: Hollowed officer following the holding-yard orders

ruth.name: Ruth
ruth.role: Prisoner organizer who keeps people together

lc.ward.first.text: Holding yard. No visitors. State your work detail.

choices.text: Fourth cart. West yard. The shift orders are here.

effects.title: A quiet entrance
effects.text: Ward accepted the shift orders. Find Ruth by the first cage yard.

choices.text: The King sent me. You don't want to keep him waiting.
What work details are allowed?

voice.speaker: ward
voice.emotion: Male voice. Controlled, calm and almost normal, but with no warmth. Never a snarling zombie.
voice.direction: Male voice. Controlled, calm and almost normal, but with no warmth. Never a snarling zombie.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. At the front gate

lc.ward.rules.text: Orders decide who passes. Check the records desk west of here.

choices.text: I'll check the desk.
These people have families.

voice.speaker: ward
voice.emotion: Matter-of-fact. He is applying instructions, not offering a favor.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. Learning how to pass

lc.ward.families.text: Families may request transport together. All names must be entered in the record.

choices.text: That is not what I meant.

voice.speaker: ward
voice.emotion: Polite administrative tone. The horror comes from the lack of concern, not a villain laugh.
voice.direction: Polite administrative tone. The horror comes from the lack of concern, not a villain laugh.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. A disturbing, ordinary-sounding answer

lc.ward.pass.text: Fourth cart. West yard. Shift change. Order matches. The work detail will use the other stairs. Proceed.

choices.text: Understood.

voice.speaker: ward
voice.emotion: A slight pause while checking the order. No sense of choosing to help the player.
voice.direction: A slight pause while checking the order. No sense of choosing to help the player.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. Paperwork redirects the work detail

lc.ward.done.text: Your assigned path is open. Do not delay the next transport.

choices.text: I heard you.

voice.speaker: ward
voice.emotion: Flat, efficient, no hostility unless orders require it.
voice.direction: Flat, efficient, no hostility unless orders require it.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. Brief response after entry

lc.ward.fail.text: No personal orders were received. False authority. Guards: seize the speaker.

choices.text: Then I'll open the gate myself.

voice.speaker: ward
voice.emotion: Same calm voice. The command is the danger. Fighting waits until dialogue ends.
voice.direction: Same calm voice. The command is the danger. Fighting waits until dialogue ends.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. Unsupported bluff exposed

lc.ward.locked.text: Remain where you are. The gate is closed.

choices.text: We will see about that.

voice.speaker: ward
voice.emotion: Short and final, not angry. He cannot be talked into changing sides.
voice.direction: Short and final, not angry. He cannot be talked into changing sides.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. The combat route remains possible

lc.ruth.first.text: Caleb escaped? Good. Free both cage yards. The winch above calls more guards.

choices.text: Let's get them out. Tell me what you need.

effects.title: Get the prisoners out
effects.text: Free the south and north cage groups, stop the raised alarm winch, and open the escape gate. You choose the order. Ruth will guide the freed groups to shelter.

choices.text: I'm here for the crossing, not everyone in these cages.

effects.title: Get the prisoners out
effects.text: Free the south and north cage groups, stop the raised alarm winch, and open the escape gate. You choose the order. Ruth will guide the freed groups to shelter.

voice.speaker: ruth
voice.scene: A rescue with people behind it
voice.emotion: Female voice, tired but firm. Dry affection when mentioning Caleb. Practical, not helpless.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. A rescue with people behind it

lc.ruth.curt.text: You need the gates open to reach the north crossing. Help with those; I'll help the people.

choices.text: Where are the locks?

voice.speaker: ruth
voice.scene: A selfish answer has a social cost
voice.emotion: Keep the anger quiet. She gives the required directions anyway.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. A selfish answer has a social cost

lc.ruth.plan.text: Each yard has a lock. Cut the alarm cable for fewer interruptions. Free both groups, reach the shelter, then open the escape gate.

choices.text: Is that everyone?

effects.title: One more cage
effects.text: Ruth says a small group is held in the old raised cage on the west side. Their rescue is optional; she refuses to forget them.

choices.text: You have gone quiet.
The old cage is open. They are coming back.
What is waiting at the crossing?

voice.speaker: ruth
voice.scene: Clear plan, free choice of task order
voice.emotion: Steady, concise directions. No artificial countdown.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. Clear plan, free choice of task order

lc.ruth.extra.text: More prisoners are in the old cage on the west shelf. Please rescue them too.

choices.text: I'll look for them.

voice.speaker: ruth
voice.emotion: Compassion with restrained anger. Do not reveal the freight puzzle.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. Optional rescue of overlooked prisoners

lc.ruth.repair.text: A prisoner needs water. Fill these flasks at the clean spring beyond the loaded wagon.

choices.text: I brought clean water. Give him this.
I'll see what I can do.

effects.title: An empty flask
effects.text: Ruth is worried about a boy who needs water. A clean spring lies beyond the loaded wagon on the east side.

voice.speaker: ruth
voice.scene: A natural clue for repairing trust
voice.emotion: Low, distracted concern for the child. No demand for an apology quest.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. A natural clue for repairing trust

lc.ruth.water.text: Thank you. He needed that water badly.

choices.text: Tell me about the people still missing.

voice.speaker: ruth
voice.scene: Trust repaired by an actual helpful act
voice.emotion: Relief first. Honest, gentle correction, not a lecture.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. Trust repaired by an actual helpful act

lc.ruth.reward.text: Everyone's free. Take this Rift Shard as thanks.

choices.text: Keep everyone together.

voice.speaker: ruth
voice.scene: Optional rescue earns a Rift Shard
voice.emotion: Warm, deeply relieved. Small laugh at the shoe after the emotion lands.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. Optional rescue earns a Rift Shard

lc.ruth.safe.text: We'll wait under cover until the crossing is safe.

choices.text: About that crossing...

voice.speaker: ruth
voice.emotion: Hopeful and grounded. A fond joke about Caleb, not ridicule.
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Lost Canyon. Prisoners await transport to Ruined Keep. No one knows the player is Bladeborn. After the optional reward

lc.ruth.marksman.text: A Hollowed marksman guards the last crossing. Use cover and alternate paths. Beyond it, follow the records to Ruined Keep.

choices.text: Stay under cover. I'll find a way.

voice.speaker: ruth
voice.scene: Sets up the next boss without spoiling its exact mechanics
voice.emotion: Serious, useful warning. No claim that the King is at the Keep.

effects.title: Shift orders
effects.text: Fourth cart. West yard. Shift change. Ward is ordered to admit a work detail carrying these papers and redirect his detail to the other stairs.

effects.title: The front gate
effects.text: The chain brought three guards to the gate. Clear them, then work the gate handle. The high side path is another way in.

effects.title: Above the gate
effects.text: The side ladder drops into the holding yard. Ward never saw you use it.

effects.title: South cage opened
effects.text: The freed group is taking a sheltered route to Ruth.

effects.title: North cage opened
effects.text: The freed group is taking a sheltered route to Ruth.

effects.title: Extra cage opened
effects.text: The freed group is taking a sheltered route to Ruth.

effects.title: Alarm stopped
effects.text: The cable is cut. Opening another cage will not call more guards.

effects.title: Escape route open
effects.text: Both cage groups can reach the shelter and the alarm is stopped. Make the last crossing safe for them.

effects.title: A different way out
effects.text: Unloading the wagon cleared the cave. The canyon floor beyond it has a climbing route back to the northern path.

effects.title: Clean water
effects.text: You filled a flask at the spring beyond the wagon. Someone in the holding yard may need it.

effects.title: The freight track
effects.text: The cart is held by a brake high above the sealed store. The old-cage ledge leads to its scaffold. A fall lands on the freight road below.

effects.title: Freight store open
effects.text: The brake released the loaded cart. It rolled along the track and uncovered the store below.
